criterion_text: — Creation-time persistence and visibility. In an isolated Agent+tmux fixture, a single create request with title/description/tags succeeds; immediate Get and list-summary readback on the returned incarnation report the same normalized initial context, persisting across a metadata-store/Agent restart. Creating without metadata still produces the expected empty revision-0 metadata.

verifiers.summary: Create-time initial metadata is committed, durable across restart and defaults to revision 0

evidence.value: nession-agent at exact SHA 5cd4477378b8360cce2b9724dd989516b1e24ed2: a create with title/description/tags committed normalized revision 1 for its own tmux incarnation; a fresh metadata store over the same Session read the same record; a create without metadata produced the confirmed revision-0 record

verifiers.summary: Immediate Get and list-summary readback observe the committed initial context
